method: Per-person public web research (WebSearch) for every TeamInfo member in batches 2017-2023, starting from research/v8-alumni-companies.json. Sources: LinkedIn search-result titles/snippets for the exact TeamInfo slug or name + BITS Pilani/DVM (LinkedIn never fetched directly), GitHub API company/bio fields for every member with a GithubLink, personal sites, Devfolio/Peerlist, YC/Crunchbase/TheOrg, data brokers (ZoomInfo, RocketReach, Apollo, Weekday) when tied to the exact slug or DVM, and the official BITS Pilani PS-I/PS-II Chronicles PDFs (PS-I 2024 and Summer 2025, PS-II 2024-25 and 2025-26), matched on full name + batch-year ID + Pilani campus suffix. 'latest' = current full-time role if any (founders count as full-time), else the most recent internship (incoming offers included). Excluded: BITS itself (incl. PIEDS/BITS research), DVM, clubs, fests, universities/PhDs, GSoC/LFX/MLH-style programs, accelerators, government ministries/regulators. Confidence: high = own profile/matched slug/unambiguous; medium = strong but indirect. All 164 people received LinkedIn-style searches (the 15 people missed in round 1 because of a search cap were searched in a second round).
